caption:
Kya ply sach mein waterproof hoti hai? Paani lagte hi ply phool kar kharab ho jati hai.

VAJRA PP shuttering sheet paani se bilkul nahi phoolti aur sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai. Column aur slab dhalai mein paani ki no tension.

Apne thekedar aur mistri bhai ko zaroor share kijiye.
